name: High Elf

choices.label: Choose one cantrip from the Wizard spell list
Choose one extra language of your choice

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

description: As a high elf, you have a keen mind and a mastery of at least the basics of magic.

name: Hill Dwarf

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

description: As a hill dwarf, you have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.

name: Lightfoot Halfling

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

description: As a lightfoot halfling, you can easily hide from notice, even using other people as cover.

name: Rock Gnome

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device.

description: As a rock gnome, you have a natural inventiveness and hardiness beyond that of other gnomes.
